title: Grumps are shown as squeezed pets/animals, not converted Crystopia crystals (Tom 17:12 #1)
repro: p1_grump_truth: Big Grump leaves a dog collar 'BISCUIT', Star Crystal: 'He takes something that loved and squeezes... That was somebody's dog'. p2_catkins: 'turns back into whatever it was... a rabbit, a frog, a deer'. Companion.REVERT maps grump->rabbit, big_grump->deer, slime->frog. Meanwhile campaign.gd flavour() says Grumps 'turn back into crystals' (Crystopia). Two systems tell opposite origins.
fix: Rewrite p1_grump_truth: where the Big Grump falls, a small glowing crystal shakes off the grey and floats up/away; Star Crystal: 'He doesn't make Grumps. He talks to my people, the crystals of Crystopia, until they believe him, and then they forget who they were.' Keep the collar as an optional side thread only if Tom wants (Tom #30 allows some non-crystal creatures) or drop it plus the epilogue dog line. p2_catkins line 5: 'it turns back into the crystal it was before... and some of the others he took: little creatures too'. Companion.REVERT: grump/big_grump/shard -> a crystal-sprite critter (new) that floats off; keep animal reverts only for non-Grump wildlife (slime, bat, wolf).
art_needed: crystal_sprite critter (small floating Crystopia crystal with a face, idle+float strip, purple/blue/pink variants)
needs_tom: Keep the Biscuit collar/old dog thread as a 'creature beyond crystals' exception, or cut it?

title: Crystal babies revert into moon rabbits, contradicting the story where they stay babies and Coldy joins
repro: Companion.REVERT has crystal_baby -> moon_rabbit. p3_babies/p3_coldy (book): Meow Pow Wow lifts their curse, they talk, and the leader Coldy joins; the other babies stay as guardians (epilogue: 'Coldy and the crystal babies stamp around the field').
fix: Remove crystal_baby (and finargle/finargle_elder, which the story turns not into owls but into a 'fuzzy thing with no mouth') from REVERT; reverted babies play a happy stamp/wave and walk back to their caves (calmed state), finargles blink and vanish into shadow.

title: Penguins never touch the Star Crystal: partner scene and Pip-Pip say they 'followed the light from very far'
repro: Book: two brave penguins, brother and sister, crept up to the crystal and touched it and got powers. Chapter p1 summary says 'Two brave penguins touched it' but no beat shows it. companions.json partner_scene.penguins: 'We followed the light. From very far.'; Pip-Pip join line: 'I was going to find the crystal on my own.' Also town intro calls the penguins 'the island's old families', so they are local, not from far away.
fix: Night 1 (farm._intro_penguins, after the Star Crystal speaks): add 2-3 lines: everyone else on the island hid; two small penguins crept to the fence and touched her; light runs up their flippers (pic cut panel). Rewrite partner_scene day 2: 'We touched it. Last night. In YOUR field. Now everything hums.' Pip-Pip join: 'I touched it first. Nova says she did. Together is warmer.'
art_needed: story panel ui/cut_penguins_touch (two penguins touching the purple star crystal at night)

title: Timeline hole: town lore says something fell 21 years ago (bell, lighthouse, mine log) but the Star Crystal falls on night 1; Auk 'went to find the crystal before I hatched'
repro: hearts.json (Marlowe/Theo/lighthouse/appraiser threads): 'the bell cracked the same night something fell in the east... Twenty-one years ago'; p4_bell_rung/p5_bell_help: 'Twenty-one years of rust'. Penguin intro: she falls tonight, first time ('looking for a place that still had joy'). p3_knight_nova: Grandfather Auk 'went to find the crystal before I hatched'; impossible if she only just fell. Tom #7: ALL timelines must match.
fix: Pick one penguin-arc canon and write it everywhere: 21 years ago the Dark Crystal's army first passed over the island chasing her (red sky; the bell cracked; the lighthouse lens cracked; Auk flew after the light and was taken); she hid in the deep stars, and on night 1 she finally comes down. Intro line: 'I passed over here once before, long ago, running. Your bell cried out. I'm sorry for that.' Make hearts.json lines arc-aware ('something passed over' for penguins) via the existing per-arc text pattern; p3_knight_nova: 'He flew after the red sky the night the bell broke, before I hatched.'
needs_tom: Confirm the 21-years-ago canon (army passing over / her first escape) for the penguin arc.

title: Tower bell contradicts itself and is not tied to the Star Crystal's visit (Tom #7)
repro: p1_town: 'a bell tower with no bell in it'. hearts.json: the bell is 'in the plaza, cracked', the clapper cracked and fell. p4_bell_rung: 'Twenty-one years of rust come off it'. p4_tele: the bell is introduced only at the end as Alder's gold-clapper favour; the Star Crystal has no link to it.
fix: p1_town: 'a bell tower whose bell hangs silent, its clapper gone'. Seed it on night 1: when she lands, the silent bell hums once on its own (Star Crystal: 'Something in your town remembers me'). p1_howl or p2: Star Crystal explains the bell broke the night the army chased her past (see timeline finding) and a rung bell is 'a town that's awake'. Keep alder_gold, but have the Star Crystal give the bell lines a payoff in p5_bell_help: 'That bell broke for me. Now it rings for you.'

title: Crystopia and Celestica are never named; the Star Crystal's home planet and the trip there are missing
repro: grep: 'Crystopia' appears only in campaign.gd, 'Celestica' nowhere. Book: the Star Crystal asks the penguins to save HER planet; they fly to Celestica (Cat-topia inside a storm tornado), then the catship flies to Crystopia, whose heart is Mount Prismatica. In-game, the crystal meadow, the Wastes and the mountain are plain walks from the valley; p2_spark's catship never lands anywhere; p3_mountain just says 'The mountain. Catkins said it: Prismatica'.
fix: Name them in beats: intro/p1_grump_truth: 'my home, Crystopia, where every crystal sang... he's turning them one by one'. p2_arrive: 'Cat-topia, on Celestica: the crystal meadow is where our worlds touch' (the rings overhead are Celestica's). p2_spark ending: the catship lands at the foot of the mountain: 'Crystopia. Mount Prismatica. From here you go on foot.' p3_mountain then calls back to it. One framing line explains why you can walk there (the Star Crystal's landing thinned the sky: the valley's far meadows open onto other worlds).
needs_tom: OK to frame the meadow/mountain as places where Dreamhollow touches Celestica and Crystopia (walkable), rather than flying?

title: Catkins never sends the penguins alone to Mount Prismatica; p2_dream and p3_mountain quote a line she never says
repro: Book key beat: at Crystopia Catkins says 'It is now up to the two of you... find your way to the heart of Crystopia at Mount Prismatica'. No beat has it. p2_dream: 'Catkins called it Prismatica'; p3_mountain: 'Catkins said it: Prismatica'. Neither is true in the script.
fix: Add the line to p2_spark after the crash (or a new p2_send beat when the Commander falls): Catkins: 'It is now up to you. Go to the heart of Crystopia, Mount Prismatica. Only inside it can you master the Meow Pow Wow. I wish you luck.' Set flag catkins_sent; p3_mountain when-condition can use it.

title: Coldy's sacred key to the heart of Mount Prismatica is never used (hint calls it a keepsake)
repro: p3_coldy gives sacred_key ('I hold the sacred key to the heart of Mount Prismatica'), hint: 'the sacred key is a keepsake from the babies'. grep: sacred_key only in companion.gd FENCE_KEEP. The finale needs only quest teleporter.
fix: Make the key open the heart: p5_spire requires item sacred_key (or flag babies_done); Coldy line before the spire: 'This is the door. The key is the song.' Or gate the teleporter's last step on it. Fix the hint text in p3_coldy.

title: Mer's under-mountain ocean tunnels 'to the very top' are promised then dropped; Heart of Prismatica placed both deep in the mine and at the summit
repro: p4_merkitties: 'take them through the under-mountain ocean tunnels to the very top'; hint: 'The way to the top is the mountain pad now' and the teleporter needs 3 Refined Crystals. p2_dream: the heart beats 'far below... every floor down is a floor closer to me' (mine). Chapter 5 'The Heart of Mount Prismatica' happens on the moon spire. PENGUIN-ARC.md planned a flooded tunnel from the grotto to the moon station; not built.
fix: Either: merkitty tunnel = the teleporter's power (Mer: 'The tunnels end under the pad; the water there needs the three crystals to rise'), p4 teleporter quest text says so; or add a short swim passage from the lake grotto to the pad. Reword p2_dream so the voice is the heart calling UP ('every step up is a step closer'), or name the moon spire the heart's crown in p5_spire, so heart = summit consistently.
